_comment: Empirical run: 1000 Genomes phase 3 (GRCh37), the 22 scored populations, all autosomes.
inputs: fetch the public files with empirical/download_inputs.sh; ancestral_dir and
exclude_rsids are described in README section 7. Memory: production used 64 GB per
stats task and 25 GB per annotate task; lower workers if a PC has less.
